sloka: राज्य हेतोः स चेत् भ्राता भ्रात्रा कॄरेण पातितः ।रामेण प्रसृतैः दूरात् मार्गणैः दूर पातिभिः ॥४-१९-९॥
transliteration: rājya hetoḥ sa cet bhrātā bhrātrā kṝreṇa pātitaḥ ।rāmeṇa prasṛtaiḥ dūrāt mārgaṇaiḥ dūra pātibhiḥ ॥4-19-9॥

translations.english: 'If the (elder) brother is struck down by his (younger) brother in anger for the sake of kingship using farreaching arrows discharged by Rama, why are you running?'
